C5.for_what_part: No plan instrument covers it. The record shows the reads. 'scope of a call' can be asked for on named read lines during the work.

C8.for_what_part: Recipients identical to those promoted, wording identical to the approved wording, and the number to send. The notices actually ordered are checked afterwards, at A3.

C9.for_what_part: The sending calls confirmed and those ordered and not confirmed, against the release. It speaks only as of the time it was taken. Calls in doubt stay in doubt.

C10.for_what_part: 'sent as released' reads the record, not the outbox. 'trace of a call' on named lines is needed, for example for any call that was ordered and not confirmed.
